schema_documentation:
11 top-level keys, all scalars (no nesting). Two variants: 341,617 records with `text`, ~145 with `text_clean` instead (README; my 1/11 sample found 15 → ≈165 est).
- `id` str 100% — numeric string, 3-6 chars, matches url
- `category` str 100% — 6 enum values; 1/11-sample counts: Πολιτική 9,145 / Κόσμος 9,038 / Ελλάδα 6,831 / Οικονομία 3,759 / Πολιτισμός 1,545 / Επιστήμη 751
- `title` str 100% non-empty — mean 75 chars, max 248
- `abstract` str 100% present, 29.9% non-empty (102,249 / 341,762, exact full-file count; README agrees) — mean 49 chars overall; **of the 9,315 non-empty in my 1/11 sample, 8,048 (86.4%) are a verbatim prefix of the body**
- `author` str 100% present, 21.4% non-empty — byline
- `tags` str 100% present, 10.9% non-empty — comma-separated keywords
- `created` int 100% — Unix ms epoch
- `modified` int 100% — Unix ms epoch
- `url` str 100% — https://www.amna.gr/home/article/{id}/
- `text` str 99.97% — raw scraped body, `\r\n` line endings, NO markdown
- `text_markdown` str 100% present / 99.97% non-empty — same body with `**bold**` and `[label](url)` links injected
- `text_clean` str, present in only ~145 records, **100% empty string** (abandoned cleaning pass)
